headline: Ebrard asks China's Commerce Minister to reduce the trade imbalance with Mexico
summary: Mexican Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard asked China's Commerce Minister Wang Wentao to reduce the trade imbalance between Mexico and China.
why: Mexico's trade with China is a significant point of tension, as Mexico runs a large deficit with the Asian economy and trade policy shapes its manufacturing and tariffs.
original_headline: Ebrard pide al ministro de Comercio de China disminuir el desequilibrio comercial con México
